scope: src/broker.ts lifecycle responsibilities after dispatcher extraction
reason: The remaining listener/connection, run-endpoint and drain paths still share admission health, Store lifetime, storage reservations and task settlement. Extracting them now would replace local methods with callback/port plumbing without reducing the files required for a lifecycle change.
splitTriggers: listener/drain changes repeatedly require reading dispatcher or mutation code
a listener-lifetime extraction can own Server/connection/task sets without callbacks into Broker except admission/error reporting
actor endpoint lifetime can move without duplicating Store incarnation or RunRegistry authority
the measured file/change surface decreases after the extraction
